transport.airport_to_city: Narita Express (NEX) to Shinjuku/Tokyo Station — 60 min, ~3500 INR. Haneda is closer: monorail/taxi 30 min.
transport.within_city: JR Pass covers most trains. Suica/Pasmo IC card for subway. Avoid taxis in rush hour.
tips: Get a 72-hour Tokyo Metro pass
Google Maps works perfectly for train navigation
Last trains around midnight

timing_advice.rush_hours: 7:30-9:30 AM, 5:30-8:00 PM — avoid subway during these times

local_customs: Bow when greeting
No tipping
Remove shoes indoors
Quiet on public transport
Cash still widely preferred at small shops

transport.airport_to_city: From Osaka Kansai (KIX): Haruka Express 75 min, ~2800 INR.
transport.within_city: Bus system is excellent for temple hopping. Rent bicycles for flat areas. Taxis reasonable for short trips.
tips: Get a Kyoto Bus 1-day pass
Temples close by 5 PM
Arashiyama is best reached by JR train

local_customs: Geisha district (Gion) — do not photograph without permission
Temple etiquette: purify hands at chozuya
Dress modestly at shrines

transport.airport_to_city: Kansai Airport Rapid to Namba — 50 min, ~1200 INR. Nankai Rapi:t limited express is faster.
transport.within_city: Osaka Metro covers all major areas. Day passes available. Walking is great in Dotonbori/Namba.
tips: Osaka Amazing Pass includes attractions + transport
Shinkansen to/from Kyoto is just 15 min

local_customs: Osaka is more casual than Tokyo/Kyoto
Street food is the culture — embrace it
Stand on the right side of escalators (opposite of Tokyo)

transport.airport_to_city: Velana International Airport is on Hulhulé island. Speedboat/seaplane transfers to resorts arranged by hotel.
transport.within_city: Male city is walkable. Ferry to nearby islands. Resorts handle all inter-island transfers.
tips: Confirm resort transfer in advance
Seaplane transfers only operate in daylight
Keep USD cash for tips

local_customs: Alcohol only on resort islands
Conservative dress in Male city
Friday is the holy day — limited services

transport.airport_to_city: Jaipur Airport to city center — 30 min by taxi, ~500 INR.
transport.within_city: Auto-rickshaws, Uber/Ola available. Hire a car+driver for full-day fort visits.
tips: Negotiate auto fares beforehand
Car+driver for Amber Fort, Nahargarh circuit
Avoid driving yourself

local_customs: Haggling expected at bazaars
Cover shoulders/knees at temples
Drink bottled water only
Rajasthani hospitality is warm — accept chai when offered

transport.airport_to_city: Jodhpur Airport to Old City — 15 min by taxi, ~300 INR.
transport.within_city: Auto-rickshaws for short trips. Walking in Old City. Car+driver for Bishnoi village safari.
tips: Old City is best explored on foot
Hire local guide at Mehrangarh
Evening walk in the blue lanes

local_customs: The Blue City is photogenic but ask before photographing homes
Try mirchi vada from local stalls
Sunset from Mehrangarh is unmissable

transport.airport_to_city: Maharana Pratap Airport to Lake Pichola area — 25 min by taxi, ~400 INR.
transport.within_city: Walking around the lake areas. Boats for lake crossings. Auto-rickshaws elsewhere.
tips: Stay near Lake Pichola for best access
Evening boat ride is a must
Fateh Sagar Lake for quieter mornings

local_customs: Known as City of Lakes and Venice of the East
Miniature paintings are the signature craft
Evening aarti at Jagdish Temple

transport.airport_to_city: Ngurah Rai Airport to Ubud — 90 min by car, ~1500 INR. Pre-book hotel transfer.
transport.within_city: Rent a scooter or hire a private driver. Grab app works. Walking in central Ubud.
tips: Private driver for full day ~2500 INR
Roads are narrow and winding
Monkey Forest is walkable from center

timing_advice.rush_hours: Traffic jams common on main road 10 AM-1 PM

local_customs: Wear sarong/sash at temples (usually provided)
Offerings on sidewalks — don't step on them
Nyepi Day of Silence — no activity, airport closed

transport.airport_to_city: Ngurah Rai Airport to Seminyak — 30 min by car, ~800 INR.
transport.within_city: Walking along beach road. Grab for rides. Scooter rental popular. Hotel shuttles.
tips: Sunset beach clubs are walkable from most hotels
Traffic bad on Jl. Raya Seminyak 4-7 PM
Pre-book airport transfer

local_customs: Beach clubs have dress codes for dinner
Respect temple ceremonies even on beach
Tipping 10% appreciated at restaurants
